sub_parameters.name: DbName
sub_parameters.description: The name of the database to which the parameter applies.

sub_parameters.name: ParamRanges
sub_parameters.description: The valid value range of the parameter.

sub_parameters.name: ParamType
sub_parameters.description:
The parameter type. Valid values:

- **ATOM**: a configuration item in the Layer 3 data source.
- **CONFIG**: a configuration item in Server Config.
- **DIAMOND**: a configuration item in Diamond.

parameters.name: ParamLevel
parameters.description:
The level at which the parameters are configured. Valid values:

- **NSTANCE**: instance level
- **DB**: database level.
